Bindings.Binding: if LazyGCore and LazyGCore.UI and LazyGCore.UI.Display then LazyGCore.UI.Display:Toggle() end
if LazyGCore and LazyGCore.UI and LazyGCore.UI.Options then LazyGCore.UI.Options:Toggle() end
if LazyGCore and LazyGCore.Settings then local v = not LazyGCore.Settings:Get("enabled") LazyGCore.Settings:Set("enabled", v) LazyGCore:Print(LazyGCore.L[v and "Enabled" or "Disabled"]) end
